_help: Copy this file to contrib/<id>.json and fill every one of the 38 cells.
Keys starting with '_' are hints; the validator ignores them and a maintainer strips them.
A cell is EITHER a value with evidence and confidence: set value, set evidence to '"<verbatim quote>" (<locator>)', add "confidence": "high" | "medium" | "low", and keep not_reported false;
OR not_reported: true with value null, when the sources you read are silent (say in note which place, such as a config file or tool list, the sources did not include);
OR unresolved: true with value null, when you cannot decide (say why in note).

Absence is not silence: if you opened the place where the feature would be declared (config model, CLI flags, tool registry, run loop, feature list) and it is not there, code the absence value (none, ...) and quote that place; not_reported is for when no such place was in the sources (coding manual rule 5).
Locators: path/to/file.py:LINE@<commit> for code at the pinned commit; 'arXiv:<id> Sec. N' for a paper.
Fill pinned_version first. Rules for each dimension: docs/coding_manual.md.
